registerContract: Two rail registers, constant per lesson (mode constant, all three you turns equal; no shift/relay lesson in P1/P2; interlocutor speaks turns 0,2,4 only). polite = single professional addressee (agent, manager, rental staff, shop owner, mentor, board, accountant, consultant, association secretary): kamo/ninyo/inyo/inyoha for the addressee as this course's chosen polite convention (widely used in formal Cebuano address but not a grammatical rule of the language; ka to a professional is not wrong Cebuano, only outside this course's polite register), palihug on request lines only, full sentences, no slang clitics (bitaw, uy, diay); learner is ko/nako/ako, exclusive mi/namo for the learner's own team, inclusive ta/nato only when the addressee is genuinely part of the group. casual = friend, neighbor, colleague, newcomer: ka/nimo/imo, lang/man/gyud softeners allowed in learner lines (never as speak tokens), inclusive ta/nato when deciding together. Sir/Ma'am borrowings only inside them-lines, never learner lines, chips, recall or trophies. Honorific direction: learner never uses kamo to a friend and never ka to the polite addressee within one lesson. Banned everywhere: po, opo, pakisuyo, kayo, hindi, kasi, kumain, magkano, Tagalog ng/ay ('kayo' is not a Cebuano spelling; Cebuano 'kaayo' is a different token and unaffected).
genderSafety: No grammatical gender; siya/niya, adjectives and verbs never agree. All 20 lessons speakerGender neutral, no alternates, in both de and en base texts. Learner lines never self-label gender or marital status; gendered words for third parties are allowed because they describe someone else, never the speaker (inahan 'mother' in P1 L9 is such a case; igsoon, uyab, kauban are the gender-neutral kin and companion terms used elsewhere); captions name roles. Generic gender detector pass is empty by design; genderClaimVerified reviewed as not applicable.
orthography: Standard Visayan spelling continuous with A1/A2/B1: ni- completed canonical in learner lines and, for TTS consistency, in them-lines of these twenty lessons (mi- recognised in reading as a regional variant only; never an authored token, accepted answer or full-line variant in this batch), nag- progressive, mo-/mag- future; object focus gi-/-on/i- and -a/-i imperatives productive from P1 L1 (B1 staging was prerequisite, not a ban); 'ug' conjunction, 'og' indefinite marker; 'kung' canonical, 'kon' listed variant; fused koy/kay/tay without apostrophe in dialogue only; glottal hyphen words (bug-at, pag-usab, tan-awon, bag-o, nakat-onan, mag-abang) allowed in dialogue text, never as speak token, blank answer, recall answer or trophy. Loanwords fixed now: bentaha, disbentaha, epekto, gasto, proseso, kalidad, prayoridad, porsyento, diskwento, kodigo, kumpirmahon, rekomendasyon, rekord, piso; English scene nouns kept lowercase as used (app, website, email, text, card, staff, weekend, parking, slot, offer, router, drill, security, overtime, grocery, permit, clearance), CCTV uppercase. Decided spellings with no accepted alternative: card (not kard), text (not teks), kumpirmahon (not kompirmahon), kadaghanan (not kadaghan); 'sentence' is not used, 'linya' is. Numbers: native for counts (duha, tulo, lima, pito), Spanish-derived for money/time (singko mil, dos mil, dos syentos kwarenta, alas dyes, singkwenta); no digits in voiced text. kaysa written as one word canonical; 'kay sa' accepted variant only where listed.
segmentation: Unit = token (letters/digits with internal hyphen/apostrophe), scale 1, joiner U+0020. Lengths: them 6-20, you1 14-26 (build focus span 7-12), you2 12-24, you3 10-22. Build: 5-8 chunks of 1-4 tokens, framePrefix + chunks + frameSuffix reconstruct dialogue[1] exactly; second-position clitics (ba, na, pa, man, ra, lang, gyud, kaha, diay, sad) and pronoun enclitics (ko, ka, siya, mi, ta, nato, nako, ninyo, nila) never a chip alone and stay in their host chunk; nga and sa attach to the following chunk; kay/kung/aron/bisan/sanglit/busa open their clause chunk; focus and aspect affixes never split. Cloze/synthesis: blanks are whole inflected words or phrases of at most 3 tokens, never a bare clitic, pronoun, marker or bound morpheme; recall answer 1-3 tokens content word. Speak: 3 targets (turn 1,3,5), 2-4 distinct whole tokens each, no clitics, no hyphen/apostrophe tokens; profile b2-long on turn 1, b2-short on 3 and 5. Trophy = exact lowercase whole token of the named turn; affixed form is the trophy when the taught form is affixed (itandi, isugyot, gitakda, magsalig, mapuslanon); no substring anchoring.
acceptedInput: Only explicitly authored acceptedAnswers per blank/recall/term (shared strict fields): kung/kon, og/ug, kaysa/kay sa where listed; no variant for kadaghanan, kumpirmahon, text or card. No full-line learner-turn or speakTarget variant lists exist in this batch: turn and speakTarget carry no acceptedVariants/acceptedAnswers key, mi- forms are never accepted answers, and any future full-line variant support is deferred to a later explicit specification exception. Intended normalization NFC + trim + collapse spaces + casefold + strip terminal punctuation only; no clitic dropping, no synonym substitution, no reordering, no prefix substitution, no autocorrection. Planned, not implemented: no ceb-PH B2 variant handling or normalization exists in the runtime or validator today.

answerMove.you2: Dili, kay kung ihapon nako ang pliti ug ang oras nga mawala, mas mahal gihapon ang Talamban.

closingMove.you3: Kuhaon nako ang kwarto sa sentro uban sa diskwento, kay mas daghan ang akong oras nga maluwas.

openingMove.them: Nakadawat ko og multa sa parking sa mall gahapon. Giunsa nimo pag-apelar kadtong imo kaniadto?
openingMove.you1: Gitakda sa mall nga sulod sa pito ka adlaw ipasa ang sulat sa opisina sa security, uban ang resibo ug litrato sa karatula.

lessons.challenge: Pero wala koy litrato sa karatula. Mawala ba dayon ang akong apela?

answerMove.you2: Sumala sa staff kaniadto, dili dayon mawala; ipasabot lang sa sulat nganong wala kay litrato, ug mahimo nimong hangyoon nga susihon nila ang CCTV.

lessons.steer: Sige. Isumaryo ang mga lakang, kay ugma pa ko makaadto.

closingMove.you3: Una, isulat ang sulat; ikaduha, ilakip ang resibo; dayon ipasa sa security sulod sa pito ka adlaw.

lessons.requiredCarrier: Gitakda sa + agent nga + clause
lessons.recycles: B1 P6 una/ikaduha/dayon, B1 P6 i- instructions, B1 P9 resibo

lessons.scene: friend asks why the planned fiesta food stall never happened

openingMove.them: Wala ba mahitabo ang inyong food stall sa fiesta? Nagdahom ko nga makita ta didto.
openingMove.you1: Wala, kay daghan ang kakulian: naulahi ang permit, nisaka ang presyo sa karne, ug nagsakit ang akong kauban sa adlaw mismo.

lessons.challenge: Pero ang permit, dili ba sayo nimo kini gipangayo? Ngano man nga naulahi?

answerMove.you2: Gipangayo nako sayo, apan ang organisador sa fiesta nangayo usab og clearance sa health, ug wala kana sa unang listahan nila.

lessons.steer: Sa ato pa, unsa ang imong buhaton sa sunod tuig aron dili na mabalik ang mga kakulian?

closingMove.you3: Sunod tuig mangutana ko sa organisador og kompleto nga listahan sa Enero, ug magpangita og ikaduhang kauban.

lessons.requiredCarrier: daghan ang kakulian: + three-item list
lessons.recycles: B1 P1 wala + ma-/na- narration, B1 P3 mangayo, B1 P7 aron

lessons.scene: IT consultant asks the learner to explain the dental clinic's current booking process before redesigning it

openingMove.them: Sa dili pa nako usbon ang inyong sistema, palihug ipasabot kung giunsa karon ang pagkuha og appointment sa inyong klinika.
openingMove.you1: Sukad sa Enero online na ang pagkuha: mopili ang pasyente og adlaw sa website, dayon motawag ang staff sa buntag aron kumpirmahon.

lessons.challenge: Apan ngano nga kinahanglan pa ang tawag kung online na man? Dili ba doble kana nga trabaho?

answerMove.you2: Doble kini, apan sa among rekord tunga sa mga nagpalista online wala moabot kung walay tawag, busa mas gamay karon ang bakante.

lessons.steer: Sige. Kung mopadala kami og text imbes tawag, unsa ang inyong gipaabot nga mahitabo?

closingMove.you3: Tingali mas barato ug mas paspas, apan sulayan una sa usa ka bulan ug ihapon kung pila ang dili moabot.

lessons.requiredCarrier: Sukad sa + time, + present-state clause
lessons.recycles: B1 P6 process steps, L1 busa, B1 P5 kung embedded

lessons.scene: skeptical neighbor challenges the learner's support for a bike lane on their street

openingMove.them: Ngano man nga nagsuporta ka sa bike lane sa atong dalan? Mas daghan ang trapik ug walay mogamit.
openingMove.you1: Nagsuporta ko kay mas gamay ang kadaut sa hangin kung bisikleta ang gamiton sa duol, ug sumala sa plano sa barangay mas luwas ang mga bata.

lessons.challenge: Pero ang usa ka linya sa sakyanan mawala. Dili ba mas dako kana nga kadaut sa mga tindahan dinhi?

answerMove.you2: Dili siguro, kay ang mga nagbisikleta mas sayon mohunong ug mopalit sa daplin kaysa sa mga nagsakyanan nga molabay lang.

lessons.steer: Sa ato pa, kung sa tulo ka bulan gamay ra ang mogamit, mouyon ka ba nga kuhaon kini?

closingMove.you3: Mouyon ko nga susihon human sa unom ka bulan, dili tulo, kay kinahanglan og panahon una mausab ang batasan.

lessons.requiredCarrier: mas gamay/dako ang kadaut sa + NP
lessons.recycles: B1 P7 kung condition, B1 P8 batasan/nausab, B1 P2 uyon, P1 L1 kaysa

lessons.scene: homeowners association secretary asks a committee member to trace how the night gate closure was decided (fictional association, scene-specific)

openingMove.them: Alang sa minutes, palihug ipasabot kanako kung giunsa pag-abot sa inyong komite ang desisyon nga sirhan ang gate sa gabii.
openingMove.you1: Nagsugod kini sa reklamo sa tulo ka pamilya, dayon gisusi sa komite ang CCTV, ug sa katapusan nagboto ang kadaghanan nga sirhan kini alas dyes.

lessons.challenge: Apan duha ka miyembro ang nisupak sumala sa akong nadungog. Giunsa ninyo pagdawat ang ilang punto?

answerMove.you2: Gidungog namo ang ilang punto bahin sa mga nagtrabaho sa gabii, busa gidugang ang kodigo sa gate alang sa mga residente.

lessons.steer: Sige. Sa usa ka linya lang, unsa ang katapusan nga desisyon ug kanus-a kini magsugod?

closingMove.you3: Sirhan ang gate alas dyes sa gabii sugod sunod Lunes, ug naa ang kodigo alang sa mga residente nga naulahi.

lessons.requiredCarrier: Nagsugod kini sa ..., dayon ..., ug sa katapusan ...
lessons.recycles: B1 P1 dayon narration, B1 P9 reklamo, L1 busa, exclusive namo

trophyLedger.forbiddenCheck: All 20 lemmas and all 20 familyKeys checked by hand under NFC+casefold against the frozen forbiddenTrophies list in the prerequisite (no separate sha is recorded for that list; 831742a6… is b1AllocationSha256, the B1 allocation ledger) and against each other: 20/20 lemmas absent, 20/20 familyKeys absent, no duplicates. All 100 B1 reservations (10 paths x 10, including paths without reviewed lessons) remain allocated and untouched; the ledger must list B1 rows before any B2 row. Trophy turnIndex is 1 for all 20; surfaces are whole tokens of dialogue[1] as written above. A mechanical re-check waits for the ceb-PH ledger tooling.
nearFamilyDecisions: Excluded because the root is a reserved B1 or earlier trophy: motuo/nagtuo (tuo), pamaagi/pinaagi (paagi), kaayohan (maayo), kasagaran (sagad), sinugdanan (sugod), mahinungdanon (hinungdan), panginahanglan (kinahanglan), angayan (angay), kalainan (lain/lahi), gawas as connector (mogawas), kaugmaon (ugma), kasabotan (kasabot), makatarunganon (tarong), kasiguroan (sigurado), moresulta (resulta).
Single-family loan decision: epekto (noun) and apekto/nakaapekto (verb) are one family 'epekto'; only epekto is a trophy, nakaapekto may appear as a term.
mapuslanon is the trophy of family 'pulos'; pulos appears as a term only (P2 L4 them-line).
disbentaha is a derivation inside family 'bentaha'; term only, never a trophy.
kabahin/bahin and 'sa laing bahin' are terms in family 'bahin'; not trophies.
Affixed trophies are frozen as the affixed token (itandi, isugyot, gitakda, magsalig); gitandi, isalig, itakda, nagsugyot are same-family terms and never separate trophies.
kahimtang, katungod, kaakohan, kasinatian, proseso, sumala, gumikan, napugos, luwas, kalidad, prayoridad are unallocated terms available to later ceb B2 paths; not consumed here.

mechanicalValidationRules: Exactly 2 paths, 10 lessons each; dialogue exactly 6 turns them/you alternating; you moves pairwise distinct; only you1 is checked against the path moveWhitelist; you2 in {concede,rebut,clarify,explain,compare,counteroffer}; you3 in {conclude,propose,summarize,counteroffer,request} (no relay in P1/P2); registerPlan.mode constant, registers equal and in {polite,casual}.

Token lengths: them 6-20, you1 14-26, you2 12-24, you3 10-22; build 5-8 chunks of 1-4 tokens, framePrefix + chunks.join(' ') + frameSuffix NFC-equal to dialogue[1]; cloze/synthesis/recall reconstruct exactly as in the contract.

Trophy: lowercase single token, no hyphen/apostrophe/digit, NFC+casefold unique against A1/A2 trophies, all 100 B1 ledger rows and all B2 rows; familyKey unique the same way; surface is a whole token of dialogue[trophyIndex] and appears in trophy.example.

Clitic/pronoun enclitic alone as chip, blank answer or recall answer → error (ba, na, pa, man, ra, lang, gyud, kaha, diay, sad, ko, ka, siya, mi, ta, nato, nako, ninyo, nila, kamo); marker alone (ang, sa, og, ug, nga, kay) → error; chunk beginning with nga/sa must contain its following word.

Banned tokens anywhere in target text → error: po, opo, pakisuyo, kayo, hindi, kasi, kumain, magkano, ng, ay; digits in voiced text → error; hyphenated or apostrophe tokens in speak requiredTokens, blank answers, recall answers, trophies → error.

Register tokens: polite lesson learner turns containing ka/nimo/imo/imoha addressing the interlocutor → warning; casual lesson learner turns containing kamo/ninyo/inyo → warning; Sir/Ma'am in any you turn → error.

Choices: exactly 4 distinct after normalization, exactly one accepted; the pairs apan/pero, kung/kon, og/ug, lang/ra, busa/maong, kaysa/kay sa, ni-/mi- forms never co-occur in one choice set → error; at most one choices-bearing blank per cloze.

Aspect flags (warning, never auto-fix): 'dili' directly before ni-/nag-/naka-/gi-/naa; 'wala' directly before ni-/nag-; base-text tense licence as in B1 rule (completed needs ni-/naka-/gi-/na- or wala + mo-/mag-/ka-; future needs mo-/mag-/ma- or future time word or kung/aron/basta clause).
Orthography: unattested spelling variants of corpus words → warning; term.targetText must occur verbatim (folded) in dialogue or a pattern example; acceptedAnswers include the answer.

Scene-specific notices (P1 L10 parking rule, P2 L2 sack colours, L4 loyalty points, L6 mall appeal window, L7 fiesta permit list, L10 gate code) are recorded in the lesson scene field as this interlocutor's local arrangement and checked under semantic review rule 9; no phrase check in product copy and no validator gate, because the ceb-PH B2 validator is not implemented.
semanticReviewRules: Challenge at turn 2 genuinely attacks the content of you1 (price, missing proof, counter-case), not a repeat; steer at turn 4 changes the task (discount, time cap, single-sentence summary, edge case, new condition); you3 answers the steer, not you1.

P1 you turns compare at least two options and the closing recommendation is qualified (kung/apan/una ... sulayi); P2 you turns name a cause, a consequence or ordered steps and hold the explanation under the precision request; reject padded B1 (list of harder nouns without argument).

Aspect and focus naturalness: gi-/na- completed vs mo-/mag- future vs -on/i- instruction match the base meaning; within these twenty lessons a reviewer flags, never rewrites, actor/object focus mixing inside one clause, 'wala' followed by ni-/nag-, busa without a stated cause, and sanglit not opening its reason clause; these are authored-pattern review items, not universal rules of Cebuano grammar.
kaysa sa before a definite noun phrase, bare kaysa before a verb phrase or predicate; reviewer flags, never auto-rewrites.

Register coherence per lesson against the named interlocutor; inclusive nato/ta only where the addressee shares the decision (P1 L5, P2 L2), exclusive namo for the learner's committee (P2 L10); honorific direction never flips inside a lesson.

Visayan idiom, no Tagalog or Hiligaynon calque, no German or English word order calque; loan nouns used only where Cebuano speakers would (app, website, CCTV); 'pulos', 'takos', 'haom' used as natives use them, not as glosses of 'nützlich/wert/passend'.
Distractors and second-valid-choice check: every chip permutation and every alternative choice reviewed for being wrong in context, not merely non-canonical; near-synonyms never as distractors.

German and English base texts idiomatic and mutually independent; both carry the aspect the Cebuano licenses; the reuse value of the exact trophy surface (e.g. itandi as object-focus invitation to compare) is shown by trophy.example, a natural sentence containing the surface, and explained in the external author report; no pedagogicalGoal, whyThisWord or other key outside the strict shared contract is authored.

Scene-specific notices (parking rule, waste sacks, mall appeal window, loyalty points, gate code) are presented as this interlocutor's local arrangement; no universal legal, medical, municipal or financial claim.
Recycling honored: each lesson visibly reuses the listed B1 carriers and earlier B2 trophies (kaysa in P1 L3-L9, busa in P2 L4/L8/L10) in dialogue, not only in metadata.
requiredSchemaExtensions: Registry: ceb-PH B2 rail row with registers ['polite','casual'], unit token, scale 1, joiner U+0020, baseRule de+en, speak profiles b2-long/b2-short (thresholds are audit metadata, not schema).
Ledger: the forbidden set for ceb B2 must be computed from frozen A1/A2 trophies plus all 100 B1 ledger rows (not only live B1 lessons), as the b2BeforeB1 resolution already requires; no new field.

Validator config (no schema change, pending, not implemented): ceb-PH clitic/enclitic stoplist, Tagalog banned-token list, register token lists, never-co-occur choice pairs; no fictional-notice phrase check.

No other change: lesson, turn, build, cloze, blank, recall, pattern, term, speakTarget, trophy and review shapes stay as in the strict contract; no pedagogicalGoal, whyThisWord, turn acceptedVariants or speakTarget acceptedAnswers keys; gender alternates unused; any Cebuano-only explanation lives in trophy.example or the external author report.
unresolvedDecisions: Independent native read of every line for clitic order after longer hosts, kaysa sa vs kaysa, gyud in casual learner lines, and the pulos/takos/haom/panglantaw usages; reviewer flags only.

Token counts were recounted by hand with the stated unit; two turns sit exactly on a bound (P1 L7 you2 24, P2 L9 you1 26), P2 L4 you1 is 25 and P1 L5 you3 is 21 after the V2 repairs, and any later edit must recount; no validator confirms this yet.

Full lessons (base texts, build, cloze, synthesis, recall, pattern, terms, speak targets), the ceb-PH B2 validator and ledger tooling, Fable full read of the authored lessons, independent native review and TTS remain pending; nothing here asserts readiness.
